title: Rustom
desc: Rustom, a naval officer, shares a happy relationship with his wife Cynthia. Soon, he discovers her affair with Vikram, a close friend, and is accused of murdering him.

title: Jhoomo Nacho Gaao Yaaro
desc: A gifted dancer suffers a devastating loss when his rival orchestrates an accident that costs him his legs. Eventually, he seeks to take revenge on his enemy.

title: Radhe Shyam
desc: Despite being a doctor with no inclination towards superstitious beliefs, Prerana places her love and faith in Aditya, a palmist whose predictions turn out to be too spot-on to be disregarded.

title: Phata Poster Nikla Hero
desc: Vishwas, the son of a widow, wants to be an actor despite his mother's wish that he become a police inspector. However, his life takes a turn when he gets entangled with a criminal gang.
